name: Michael Madigan

summary.text: Michael Madigan was Speaker of the Illinois House of Representatives for most of 1983-2021. In February 2025 a federal jury convicted him on 10 of 23 corruption counts, including bribery tied to Commonwealth Edison's arrangement of jobs and contracts for his associates; it acquitted him on seven counts and deadlocked on six. On June 13, 2025 Judge John Blakey sentenced him to 90 months and a $2.5 million fine. The Seventh Circuit affirmed on April 27, 2026, and Madigan petitioned the Supreme Court in July 2026.
